newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says Israelis, Palestinians in "crisis".
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Israelis, Palestinians in "crisis".

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said Israelis and Palestinians were in a "big crisis" after Israeli troops wounded 160 people during protests on Wednesday over Israel's Jerusalem policy.

"This is a big crisis between the Israelis and the Palestinians, and the Arabs, and the Moslems and the Christians," he told reporters in the self-ruled Gaza Strip. A Ramallah hospital said 160 Palestinians were wounded in the clashes.
